reviewScope: Read-only static review of the exact keyboard MCU image. No hardware was touched. Source-backed only; not physical validation.

firmware.hashCheck: Intel HEX and decoded image hashes recomputed on 2026-11-19 and matched the repository pins.
firmware.restriction: Source provenance, not an installed firmware version allowlist.

firmwareState.reportBase: 0x100015C8 (status at +0, data size +5, class +6, command +7, arguments from +8; status 5 = not supported)
firmwareState.records: 0x40-byte records, mode at +5; selector (storage, led) returns active (storage 0) or saved (storage 1) record

keyboardTransport.rowSemantics: Arguments [frameId (ignored), row, start, end, RGB from arg4]. Writes keyboard staging at row*0x30+col*3. row=start=end=0xFE clears the staging buffer; OpenBlade sends rows 0..5, start 0, end 15, so it can never form the sentinel. Status 5 for row 6 or higher, end 16 or higher, or start greater than end.
keyboardTransport.alternativeRowSemantics: Arguments [storage (ignored), led, row, start, end, RGB from arg5]. LED5 rows 0..5 write keyboard staging. LED5 row 6 returns success without writing. Status 5 for row 7 or higher, end 16 or higher, or start greater than end.
keyboardTransport.forbiddenAddressing: Never send 0F/03 with LED4 or LED0. LED4 rows 1..5 write logo_buffer + row*0x30, past the 0x30-byte logo buffer (RAM overwrite). LED0 rows 0..5 write keyboard staging and LED0 row 6 writes the logo buffer. Send LED5 rows 0..5 only.
keyboardTransport.persistence: Row writes only change RAM staging. Boot reloads staging from storage offset 0x210 with a CRC; the default pattern is written only after a CRC failure.
keyboardTransport.activationSemantics: Custom arm 0x9B16: LED5 sets flag[0]=1, active record mode 8 and copies staging to output. Completion 0x9B88 with storage 0 only re-initialises the renderer; nothing is persisted. LED4 and LED38 are untouched.
keyboardTransport.alternativeActivation: 03/0A [5,0] custom arm 0xACDC: flag[0]=1, copy, active record mode 8, no persistence; keyboard-only.
keyboardTransport.forbiddenActivation: 0F/02 [0,0,8] also sets the LED4 flag and record. Storage 1 activates and persists the saved bank. Neither is used.
keyboardTransport.excluded: No vapor-chamber or auxiliary frame row: 03/0B rejects row 6 and 0F/03 LED5 row 6 is a silent no-op. The logo has no admissible frame path.

restoration.baseline: Complete independently read built-in effect through the existing exact-model typed lighting read path, plus 0F/82 [0,5] mode, durably saved before any write. A baseline that already reads mode 8 has unknown staging pixels and blocks host entry.
restoration.method: Restore with the existing exact-model legacy 03/0A typed setter for the saved effect, then the existing full readback. Every built-in 03/0A arm in 0xAB3C..0xADDC clears flag[0] unconditionally before writing the saved record and activating it.
restoration.sameEffectShortcutHazard: Do not restore through 0F/02 built-ins unless a fresh 0F/82 read reports mode 8. The 0F/02 Static, Breathing, Spectrum, Wave and Off arms return early on a same-effect match without clearing flag[0] (SET table 0x978E (count 9)); from mode 8 every built-in clears the flag.
restoration.restorableModes: Whatever the existing 03/0A typed contract already restores with readback (Off, Static, Breathing, Wave; Spectrum as a mode only).
restoration.unrestorableModes: Custom (8) with unknown staging, Reactive (5), Starlight and modes 6/7, and any baseline the existing read path cannot fully read.
restoration.brightness: Neither row writes nor the custom arm touch the record brightness byte. Restore brightness through the existing exact raw path only if the journal recorded a change.
restoration.failure: Stop on ambiguous submission or confirmation; keep the durable original baseline. No startup replay or alternative sequence.

ownershipHazards.fnOverlay: Fn state with record id 5: overlay into output only (no staging reference). Transient: staging and the custom flag are untouched, so frames resume when Fn is released. Fn-row keys are overdrawn while Fn is held.
ownershipHazards.gpioEvent: Handler 0x4FB4 debounces GPIO 0x50002100 bit 8 (lid or backlight line; semantics not established). Falling edge fades out. Rising edge copies the saved records over the active records and re-initialises the renderer with the saved mode, without clearing the custom flag. Afterwards 0F/82 reports the saved mode while staging is still displayed.
ownershipHazards.gpioMitigation: Treat any 0F/82 read other than mode 8 during a frame session as an external change: stop host rendering and restore through the flag-clearing legacy 03/0A setter. Never infer the frame is off from the reported mode. Implemented as: stop without a write; restore through that setter only when 0F/82 reports exactly the journaled baseline in mode and parameters, when a new host-drawn owner may also adopt the pending baseline. Any other effect is left unchanged until the user chooses one.
ownershipHazards.idle: No idle writer of the flag or staging found; every flag store site is init, 0F/02, 03/0A or class-00 host commands
ownershipHazards.hostOnlyFlagClears: Class-00 paths clear both flags when device mode is 2 and on the factory-default restore commands. OpenBlade sends neither.
ownershipHazards.boot: Initialised data sets both flags to 0 and init 0x5A84 clears them; a reset always leaves custom mode.

limitations: Six rows x 16 columns of the LED5 keyboard only; no logo, vapor-chamber or extra row.
Send LED5 only. LED4 and LED0 frame writes are forbidden (LED4 overwrites RAM past the logo buffer).
Pixels are write-only; a mode-8 baseline is unrestorable and blocks host entry.
0F/82 mode 8 confirms selection only. The GPIO bit-8 event can change the reported mode while staging stays visible.
The Fn overlay overdraws Fn-row and arrow keys while Fn is held.
commandSequence: Fresh exact-device, competing-controller, power, session and ownership admission.
Read and durably journal the baseline: existing typed built-in read plus 0F/82 [0,5,0,...]. Refuse if it reads mode 8 or the effect is not restorable.
Confirm: 0F/82 [0,5,0,...] returns payload[2]==8; otherwise stop and reconcile read-only.
Later frames: 03/0B rows only. Re-read 0F/82 before each batch or on a bounded cadence; any mode other than 8 ends host rendering.
Exit: legacy 03/0A typed setter for the journalled effect, then the existing full readback; restore brightness only if it changed.
differencesFrom0529: 16 columns (rowDataSize 52, end column 15) instead of 19 (61, end 18).
No row 6 or second region: no vapor-chamber frame and no LED38 activation.
Restore uses the always flag-clearing legacy 03/0A setter instead of 0F/02 typed setters gated on mode 8, because the GPIO event can move the active mode off 8 while the flag stays set.
LED4 0F/03 rows overflow the logo buffer; the implementation must hard-reject them.
